origins.relation: Same ephemeral port but distinct hosts/origins: 127.0.0.1 and localhost. localhost is explicitly resolved to 127.0.0.1. The second origin is used only for cross-origin stylesheet/CORS behavior.

cases.source: Actual inline HTMLStyleElement.sheet insertRule, CSSStyleRule.style.setProperty, deleteRule, and style.textContent reset observations with computed colors and dimensions.
Inline style media mismatch/all and HTMLStyleElement.disabled/CSSStyleSheet.disabled toggles, with actual computed color and layout measurements.

A dynamic link stylesheet loads, changes href to another real stylesheet, is removed and re-added, and a 404 link reports its actual error event. The fixture records event timing, sheet state, CSSOM, computed color/size, and real request receipts.

An existing relative stylesheet link is loaded under /base/one/, then the document base href changes to /base/two/. The existing link property/sheet and request count are observed before a newly inserted relative link resolves and loads.

A same-origin external stylesheet uses a delayed @import, a relative SVG background URL, and equal-specificity cascade rules. A later link overrides the cascade and removing it reveals the earlier rule. CSSOM, Resource Timing, computed geometry, event timing, and actual request sequence are captured.

A cross-origin stylesheet without crossorigin applies but cssRules access is attempted; a second link uses crossorigin=anonymous and ACAO:* so its rules can be read. Actual computed styles and request Origin/Referer are retained.

cssRulesError.name: SecurityError
cssRulesError.message: Failed to read the 'cssRules' property from 'CSSStyleSheet': Cannot access rules

cases.source: After a same-origin link stylesheet has loaded, change href to a 450 ms synthetic CSS response. Capture link.sheet, CSSOM, load-event count, and computed style while the request is in flight and after the new sheet completes.

A valid root stylesheet imports one 404 resource and one 200 text/plain resource. Record each owner link load/error event, import CSSOM state, root declaration computed style, and actual response status/content type.
Observe load/error listeners on a dynamically inserted inline style with no import, after textContent and insertRule mutations, after an imported stylesheet finishes, and after further mutations.
Insert a disabled link with href, observe fetch/sheet/events/computed style, enable it, then disable and re-enable the successfully loaded link while counting actual requests.

scope.tested: Inline CSSOM insertRule/deleteRule and CSSStyleDeclaration.setProperty; replacing style.textContent; style media and disabled toggles; dynamic link insert/href change/remove/readd and 404 error; old-sheet state while a replacement href is pending; root stylesheet success with imported 404 and wrong-MIME responses; inline style load/error events across creation, textContent, CSSOM, and @import; disabled-link fetch, enable, disable, and re-enable; existing/new relative links after base href change; delayed @import load completion; CSS-relative SVG resource URL; stylesheet cascade order; cross-origin cssRules SecurityError versus CORS-enabled access; computed colors and layout sizes.
scope.notTested: AdoptedStyleSheets, constructable stylesheets, CSS modules, shadow-root stylesheet scoping, import maps, unusual CSS parser edge cases, CSP, integrity/crossorigin credentials modes, TLS, and filesystem origins.
scope.transport: The Node server binds only to 127.0.0.1. Chrome Headless Shell 153 uses only the synthetic 127.0.0.1/localhost origins. The configured loopback proxy never forwards. Playwright request routing aborts any other page request; background attempts are counted as locally blocked proxy requests.
